topics.title: Closing Perspective
topics.summary: Cloud-native infrastructure does not replace systems programming. It makes lifecycle and failure boundaries more frequent and explicit. The operating discipline remains: define the contract, trace the mechanism, bound resources, verify independently, measure the complete path, and preserve recovery.
